Composition & Indication

Isotretinoin 20mg — 30 Capsules (Generic for Accutane®) contains Isotretinoin 20 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Capsules at the official 20mg strength. The standard indication is the management of severe nodular acne under specialist supervision, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Isotretinoin 20mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
